messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for service `inference-api-us-west-2` (model: redwood-v2). p99=2200ms (SLO=1500ms). AlertID: A-377000-19. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/latency/inference?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-2

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created and routed to `sara` (oncall). Incident: PD-377000. Page fired at 2026-03-14T15:20:34Z.

sara: ack PD-377000. I'm oncall and taking this. Starting triage — can folks post quick checks: autoscaler status, queue depths, recent deploys?

mike: joining. looking at autoscaler now — GPU pool us-west-2 serving redwood-v2 is at 98% utilization, `replica_count=12`, `min=10`, `max=12`. Queue depth spike: request-backlog ~4200. No recent deploys in last 2h.

jess: infra metrics: network egress normal, no disk pressure. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 0.73 to 0.41 around 15:18Z. Possibly KV cache eviction thrash.

kai: from perf side: we're seeing a small fraction of long-context requests (seq_len ~12k) causing massive KV rehydration. Tail requests are inflating p99. Recommending short-term fallback to redwood-v1-quant for tail traffic and enable prefix-caching for large seqs.

alex: I can bump autoscaler but max is already 12. I'll temporarily increase `max_replicas` to 30 and set a cooldown. Running command:

```
# terraform-ish (runtime override)
patch /infra/autoscalers/us-west-2/inference-api set max_replicas=30 cooldown=120s
```

alex: applied override, scaling events starting — new pods launching (pods: +8 pending).

incident-bot: Escalation policy: will auto-escalate to tier2 in 5m if not acknowledged. Current state: acknowledged by sara.

sara: thanks. also applying a temporary rate-limit rule on public routes to reduce tail load: 10rps per client for /v1/generate for 20m.

mike: checking sidecars — saw many streams with stale KV sessions. Restarting sidecar fleet for redwood-v2 shard-3 now. Command: `kubectl rollout restart ds/sidecar-shard-3 -n inference`

jess: KV service reported brief GC pause at 15:16Z, followed by eviction storms. We're bumping in-memory cache size and switching eviction policy on a hot path. Will monitor.

kai: deploying canary route that routes 15% of new requests to `redwood-v1-quant` and 85% to `redwood-v2` as a fallback. Canary config: `route: /generate -> weights { redwood-v2: 85, redwood-v1-quant: 15 } keep_kv=false`

sara: canary in place. Observing p99 for canaryed requests (v1-quant) ~750ms, stable. Overall p99 dropping slowly.

mike: GPU pods healthy now, new pods joined, queue depth starting to fall from 4200 -> 1200 over 6m. KV hit-rate recovering to 0.62.

pagerduty-bot: PD-377000: incident status updated -> acknowledged, mitigation in progress.

alex: temp autoscaler override will be kept for 45m then revert. Please confirm if we should keep longer.

sara: keep for now, we'll reassess in 30m. Also posting quick customer impact note: initial estimate — ~5% of requests experienced >2s latency, ~1.1% errors (timeouts 504). No widespread data loss. CS: @cs-team please prepare an outbound note if customers ask.

cs-team: acknowledged, drafting a short status blurb. will coordinate with PMs.

kai: performance explanation draft: a small subset of long-context requests caused KV cache miss storms combined with autoscaler headroom limits, producing tail amplification. Mitigation: autoscale, sidecar restarts, temporary rate-limits, canary fallback to quantized smaller model. Follow-ups: add prefix-size-based routing, enforce larger KV reservation for suspected long-context workloads, add synthetic tail tests to CI.

sara: agree. creating follow-up ticket and assigning to eng-ml + eng-runtime.

sara: current status update: p99 reduced to 1180ms (under SLO). queue depth ~450. KV hit-rate 0.68. Autoscaler at 22 replicas. Keeping pager open until stable for 30m.

mike: note for postmortem: why did max_replicas cap at 12? check cloud quota and our scaling limits for this pool.

jess: logging snapshot attached (partial):
```
[15:18:02] kv-service WARN eviction_rate=0.42 rehydrate_ms=1200
[15:18:35] sidecar-3 ERROR session_stale=1 conn_drain=0
[15:19:01] autoscaler INFO scale_up request=8 reason=queue_backlog
```

sara: handing off monitoring to mike for the next hour. I'll stay reachable but need to jump to another meeting. If anything regress, notify PD-377000 and escalate.

mike: taking over watch. I'll keep the thread updated every 10m and kick oncall runbook steps if we see regression.

incident-bot: PD-377000: note added: mitigation actions taken (autoscale override, sidecar restart, canary fallback, rate-limit). Incident remains open.

sara: thanks team — great coordination. We'll capture RCA items in the ticket and schedule a postmortem runbook. Closing note: impact was limited, customers mostly unaffected, CS standing by.

mike: +1. follow-ups logged.

pagerduty-bot: PD-377000: status=monitoring. If stable for 30m, we will resolve.
